# uRban.analysis

This package aims to support decision-makers with ready-to-use analyses of urban phenomena, especially urban heat.

## Installation

You can install the development version of uRban.analysis from [GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r
Package installation can be done directly by calling: 
  'devtools::install_github("Lara-A-O/uRban.analysis")'

pak::pak("Lara-A-O/uRban.analysis")
```

## Example

This is a basic example which shows you how to solve a common problem:

```{r example}
library(uRban.analysis)
## basic example code
```

What is special about using `README.Rmd` instead of just `README.md`? You can include R chunks like so:

```{r cars}
summary(cars)
```

You'll still need to render `README.Rmd` regularly, to keep `README.md` up-to-date. `devtools::build_readme()` is handy for this.

You can also embed plots, for example:

```{r pressure, echo = FALSE}
plot(pressure)
```

In that case, don't forget to commit and push the resulting figure files, so they display on GitHub and CRAN.
